disposition_reason: Total trace-element contents by XRF of a Portuguese bentonite paste and two sulfurous peloids (Table 9), and replicate concentrations of elements released into artificial perspiration by ICP-MS (Table 12, per litre).

study.design: laboratory formulation study: one bentonite reference and two peloids matured 90 days; perspiration leaching in triplicate
study.origin: Benavila bentonite, Avis, Portugal; mineral-medicinal waters from Cro Hotel and Thermal Spa and Caldas da Rainha Thermal Hospital
study.method: XRF (Philips) on dried solids; artificial perspiration extraction with ICP-MS (Agilent 7700)
study.lod_text: ICP-MS detection limits per element printed in Table 12 (e.g. As 1.00, Cd 0.15, Pb 0.70, Sb 0.20, Tl 0.50 µg/L); XRF limits not stated
study.qa: replicate RSD <= 10%; blank artificial perspiration solution analysed (Table 11: e.g. Pb 1.93, Cr 1.82, Sn 9.96 µg/L)
